articles.summary: The Professional Women’s Hockey League is establishing Eastern and Western conferences this season and increasing the number of playoff teams from four to eight. articles.summary: A 40-year-old Toronto man is facing charges in connection with a child sexual abuse and exploitation investigation. articles.title: Pickering youth charged for allegedly threatening to carrying out school shooting
articles.summary: A Pickering youth is facing charges for allegedly threatening to carry out a school shooting and making firearm parts with a 3D printer. Durham police say that they began an investigation on Wednesday after receiving reports from multiple sources. Sources included international policing partners who reported that a male youth had allegedly made comments online […]

articles.title: Pedestrian dead after hit and run in Scarborough
articles.summary: A pedestrian is dead after a hit and run in Scarborough early Friday morning, police said. They said the driver fled the scene with no details on the vehicle at this time.

articles.title: Pedestrian dead in Scarborough hit-and-run
articles.summary: A pedestrian has died after being struck by a vehicle in Scarborough early Friday morning. Toronto police were called to Midland and McNicoll avenues just before 2 a.m. The pedestrian was pronouned dead at the scene. The driver involved fled the scene. No vehicle description has been made available. Midland was closed between Silver Star […]

articles.title: The battle between Mississauga's current and ex mayor
articles.summary: Mississauga’s current and former mayors are at odds, and the political fallout is making waves. CBC's Chris Glover speaks with two guests to analyze the high-stakes dynamic between Carolyn Parrish and Bonnie Crombie. Tune in to hear what’s driving this rivalry and what it means for local voter turnout.

articles.title: NY governor says Cornell rape accuser was ‘failed’ by people obligated to protect her
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — The woman who accused members of a Cornell University fraternity of gang rape was “failed” by people obligated to protect her, including campus police and the county prosecutor, New York Gov. Kathy Hochul said Friday.

articles.title: Rogers becomes sole owner of MLSE after purchasing remaining 25% stake
articles.summary: Rogers Communications Inc. says it has completed its purchase of the remaining 25 per cent stake in Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment from Larry Tanenbaum's Kilmer Sports Inc.

articles.title: What to see at Nuit Blanche Toronto 2026
articles.summary: Old and new favourites are among the top projects as the night’s main exhibition takes over downtown with an underground rave, marching band and more. The 12-hour event returns Saturday, Oct. 3, at sundown.

articles.title: Man arrested for alleged arson at Toronto MP's home faces charges in another fire
articles.summary: Police say a man previously charged in an alleged arson outside the Toronto home of Liberal MP Salma Zahid is now also facing charges in a fire that took place days earlier at a vacant home in Ajax, Ont.

articles.title: 4 arrested after $100K in unpaid Highway 407 tolls linked to fraud scheme: Peel police
articles.summary: Four people have been charged in an alleged fraud scheme that Peel Regional Police say has been linked to more than $100,000 in unpaid Highway 407 ETR tolls.

articles.title: Man arrested in fatal hit and run in Mississauga, police say
articles.summary: A 69-year-old Hamilton man has been arrested and charged in a fatal hit and run on Tuesday in Mississauga, Ont., Peel police say.

articles.title: OPP search for witnesses, driver after pedestrian struck by vehicle in August dies
articles.summary: Ontario Provincial Police are looking for witnesses after a 46-year-old Brampton woman was struck last month by a driver in a vehicle, who failed to remain at the scene.

articles.title: Police seek witnesses after woman, 32, fatally struck by vehicle in Richmond Hill
articles.summary: York police are looking for witnesses after a 32-year-old pedestrian died in a crash in Richmond Hill last week.
